quickSummary: The Third Law sets absolute zero entropy for perfectly crystalline pure solids. Residual entropy arises from frozen lattice disorder (CO, Ice). Kinetic molecular theory defines molecular speeds: v_rms > v_avg > v_mp (ratio 1.225 : 1.128 : 1.000).
summary: Master the Third Law, residual entropy calculations, Graham's law, and Maxwell-Boltzmann molecular speeds.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 7.1 Third Law of Thermodynamics & Residual Entropy
conceptBreakdown.title: 7.1 Third Law of Thermodynamics & Residual Entropy

summaryBox.title: Third Law & S_res
summaryBox.takeaway: lim_(T→0 K) S = 0 for perfectly crystalline solids. Disordered crystals retain S_res = k_B ln W.

conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Third Law Postulate**: *The entropy of a perfectly crystalline, pure substance approaches zero at absolute zero temperature ($0\text{ K}$)*.
• **Residual Entropy**: Non-zero entropy observed at $0\text{ K}$ due to frozen orientational microstates ($W > 1$):
$$\mathbf{S_{\text{residual}} = k_B \ln W}$$
- $\text{CO}$: $W=2 \implies S_{\text{res}} = R \ln 2$
- $\text{N}_2\text{O}$: $W=2 \implies S_{\text{res}} = R \ln 2$
- $\text{Ice} (\text{H}_2\text{O}(s))$: $W=1.5 \implies S_{\text{res}} = R \ln 1.5 \approx 3.4\text{ J/mol}\cdot\text{K}$

conceptBreakdown.heading: 7.2 Graham's Law & Maxwell-Boltzmann Molecular Speeds
conceptBreakdown.title: 7.2 Graham's Law & Maxwell-Boltzmann Molecular Speeds
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
MAXWELL-BOLTZMANN SPEED DISTRIBUTION
   v_mp = √(2RT/M)      (Most Probable Speed)
   v_avg = √(8RT/πM)    (Average Speed)
   v_rms = √(3RT/M)     (Root Mean Square Speed)
   
   Ratio: v_mp : v_avg : v_rms = √2 : √(8/π) : √3 ≈ 1.000 : 1.128 : 1.225
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Graham’s Law of Effusion**: $\mathbf{\frac{r_1}{r_2} = \sqrt{\frac{M_2}{M_1}} = \sqrt{\frac{d_2}{d_1}}}$
• **Average Kinetic Energy**:
$$\text{Per Mole: } \mathbf{E_k = \frac{3}{2} R T} \quad \vert \quad \text{Per Molecule: } \mathbf{\epsilon_k = \frac{3}{2} k_B T}$$

quickRevision: Third Law: S = 0 at 0 K for perfect crystals.
Residual entropy: S_res = R ln 2 for CO and N₂O; R ln(1.5) for Ice.
Average kinetic energy depends ONLY on absolute temperature T.
